intro.text: Welcome! Hold the mic button any time to ask me something.

line.text: A tape and rules can compute anything. Try it yourself.
ENIAC's glowing dots stand for vacuum tubes. Swap the burned out ones.
FORTRAN let engineers write formulas. Pick a statement and punch it.
Engelbart showed the mouse and hypertext links. Try clicking a link.
Flip the article into nineteen ninety-one mode and watch the meaning stay.
The Transformer lets every token look at every other. Click a word.

outro.text: That is our tour. Keep exploring every room at your own pace.

fallback.text: Sorry, I could not answer that one. Let's keep walking.
